top_changes.change: Build the named destinations as real landmarks: woven hall, drift arch, rescue jetty and docks with lived-in dressing and warm lights, signal spire, terraces, twin pumps, lookout; and replace the Veilfall crag with a tiered, vegetated monumental mountain with several broad falls, arches and base spray per the stronghold board.

Fix the Veilfall cascade and crown areas: remove the badly stretched noisy rock textures and the Meadow-green ground, use wet dark rock and dune/salt materials, add falls spray volume and keep the camera from clipping into rock walls; also stop the brown creature body filling the Tidal Cradle 90-degree view.

Break the uniform sand mounds and flat sea: damp darker shore bands, rock outcrops, driftwood, sheltered shrub/woodland pockets and varied dune forms; replace the disc stepping-stones and white guide lines with natural sandbars and foam current; add depth/reef colour variation and sea haze across distant islands.

rows.reason: The grassy domes with gray rock skirts are gone; islands are now pale rippled dune sand with sparse beach-grass clusters, matching the dunes ruling. But every island is the same smooth sand mound with no damp darker shore band, no rock, shrub or woodland pockets and abrupt water-to-sand edges, so layered shore ecology is still missing.

Only tiny dark lumps, small orange specks and generic crates sit on the sand; at the gameplay camera none has a readable item silhouette distinct from scattered pebbles.

Veilfall is no longer a clean geometric cone; it now reads as a faceted gray crag with a single white fall. It is still a small bare rock block with one narrow streak, no tiers, greenery, arches or base spray, far from the board's monumental multi-fall mountain.

Named destinations still read as empty sand slopes: Reedhaven Woven Hall shows no hall, Lantern Cove Drift Arch no arch, Shellwatch Rescue Jetty no jetty, Deep Watch Lookout is a shaded dune trough; Gull Rest's spire is a small wooden lattice and Drowned Garden's terraces are a few blocky steps at the edge of one frame.
